note: Regulatory records transcribed from the official Gazette of India Quality Control Orders downloaded into data/raw/verified_bis_2026_09_03 and validated by SHA-256. Every field below appears in the source PDF text; nothing is inferred. A standard with no record here is reported UNABLE_TO_VERIFY, never VOLUNTARY. These records attach to the BIS Product Manual document that represents each Indian Standard in this corpus - the Product Manual is not the standard text itself, and the QCO's own source_url points at the gazette notification.
